name: Wayne County, OH
findings: Wayne County has 392 nonprofit organizations. 152 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 113 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wayne County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Wayne County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
